name: context-lens
description: A pane and a one-line band showing what fills the context window, by category and by biggest item.

metrics.title: Local metrics
metrics.description: Keep counters and a short event log in this mod's own store so /ctx stats can report how good its estimates are. Never sent anywhere.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the Context Lens pane when a session starts: widget is its small form on the desktop app (a full pane elsewhere), pane is the full pane. In the terminal it shows only in a wide fullscreen layout; /ctx opens it anywhere.
